sources.title: A comprehensive review of AI-driven approaches for smart grid stability ...
sources.snippet: Abstract The stability and reliability of smart grids are essential for ensuring efficient and secure electricity delivery, particularly amid the increasing integration of renewable energy sources. This review presents a comprehensive analysis of artificial intelligence (AI)-based methods for real-time grid management, and fault detection.
